threads.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') LIKE 'evidence-room:%' THEN 'evidence_room' WHEN from_agent='djimitflo:evolution-digest' THEN 'digest' ELSE 'discussion' END kind,COUNT(*) messages,COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id')) threads,MIN(timestamp) first_at,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') GROUP BY 1

last_7d.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') LIKE 'evidence-room:%' THEN 'evidence_room' WHEN from_agent='djimitflo:evolution-digest' THEN 'digest' ELSE 'discussion' END kind,json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') action,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id')) threads FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') AND julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2

latest50.sql: WITH recent AS (SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') tid,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY last_at DESC LIMIT 50) SELECT CASE WHEN tid LIKE 'evidence-room:%' THEN 'evidence_room' ELSE 'other' END kind,COUNT(*) n FROM recent GROUP BY 1

thread_stages.sql: WITH threads AS (SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') tid,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.question') questions,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.response') responses,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning') learnings,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') NOT LIKE 'evidence-room:%' GROUP BY 1) SELECT CASE WHEN learnings>0 THEN 'has_learning' WHEN responses>0 THEN 'has_response' ELSE 'question_only' END stage,COUNT(*) n,SUM(julianday(last_at)>=julianday(?)) in7d FROM threads GROUP BY 1

activity.sql: SELECT from_agent,json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') action,COUNT(*) n,SUM(julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?)) n7d,MAX(timestamp) last_at,SUM(json_type(payload_json,'$.params.runtime_run_id')='text') with_run_id,SUM(json_type(payload_json,'$.params.usage')='object') with_usage FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') GROUP BY 1,2

models.sql: SELECT from_agent,json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.runtime') runtime,json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.model_id') model,COUNT(*) n,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.response','social.learning') GROUP BY 1,2,3

topic_classes.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.topic_ref') LIKE 'message:%' THEN 'agent_interest' WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.topic_ref') LIKE 'proposal:%' THEN 'grounding' WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.topic_ref') LIKE 'run:%' THEN 'failure' WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.topic_ref') LIKE 'claim:%' THEN 'claim_gap' WHEN json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') LIKE 'evidence-room:%' THEN 'evidence_room' ELSE 'other' END kind,COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id')) threads,SUM(julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?)) questions7d,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.question' GROUP BY 1

evidence_refs.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') action,COUNT(*) n,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(payload_json,'$.evidence')) e WHERE e.value NOT LIKE 'message:%' AND e.value NOT LIKE 'runtime:%' AND e.value NOT LIKE 'ecosystem:%')) with_nonconversation_ref,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each(json_extract(payload_json,'$.evidence')) e WHERE e.value LIKE 'file:%' OR e.value LIKE 'wiki:%' OR e.value LIKE 'loop_run:%' OR e.value LIKE 'run:%')) with_code_or_run_ref,SUM(json_array_length(json_extract(payload_json,'$.evidence'))>0) with_any_ref FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.response','social.learning') AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') NOT LIKE 'evidence-room:%' GROUP BY 1

delivery.sql: SELECT to_agent,status,json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') action,COUNT(*) n,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action') IN ('social.question','social.response','social.learning') AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') NOT LIKE 'evidence-room:%' AND julianday(timestamp)>=julianday(?) GROUP BY 1,2,3

commons_proposals.sql: SELECT s.source,s.type,s.status,COUNT(*) n,MIN(s.created_at) first_at,MAX(s.updated_at) last_at FROM self_improvements s WHERE s.id IN (SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.improvement_id') FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning' AND json_type(payload_json,'$.params.improvement_id')='text') GROUP BY 1,2,3

groundings.sql: SELECT decision,mode,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT subject_id) proposals,SUM(json_type(answers_json,'$.refinement_id')='text') with_refinement,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM judgments WHERE judgment='commons_grounding' GROUP BY 1,2

grounding_reasons.sql: SELECT decision,reason,COUNT(*) n FROM judgments WHERE judgment='commons_grounding' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 25

children.sql: SELECT s.id,s.refined_from_id,s.status,s.source,s.panel_id,s.grounding_json,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goals g WHERE g.improvement_id=s.id OR json_extract(g.metadata,'$.improvement_id')=s.id) goals FROM self_improvements s WHERE s.refined_from_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM judgments WHERE judgment='commons_grounding' AND decision='yes') ORDER BY s.created_at

child_panels.sql: SELECT p.status,json_extract(p.consensus_json,'$.decision') decision,COUNT(*) n,SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM specialist_reviews r WHERE r.panel_id=p.id)) reviews FROM self_improvements s JOIN specialist_panels p ON p.id=s.panel_id WHERE s.refined_from_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM judgments WHERE judgment='commons_grounding' AND decision='yes') GROUP BY 1,2

child_panel_fields.sql: SELECT p.id,key FROM self_improvements s JOIN specialist_panels p ON p.id=s.panel_id JOIN json_each(p.consensus_json) WHERE s.refined_from_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT subject_id FROM judgments WHERE judgment='commons_grounding' AND decision='yes') GROUP BY 1,2

reflections.sql: SELECT r.status,r.human_required,json_extract(r.metadata,'$.promotion_allowed') promotion_allowed,COUNT(*) n,MIN(r.created_at) first_at,MAX(r.updated_at) last_at FROM reflection_candidates r WHERE r.source_ref IN (SELECT 'message:'||id FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning') GROUP BY 1,2,3

reflection_links.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) learning_messages,COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id')) learning_threads,SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM reflection_candidates r WHERE r.source_ref='message:'||m.id)) direct_reflection_link,SUM(json_type(payload_json,'$.params.improvement_id')='text') proposal_links FROM agent_messages m WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning'

reflection_judgments.sql: SELECT j.judgment,j.mode,j.decision,COUNT(*) n FROM judgments j WHERE j.subject_id IN (SELECT r.id FROM reflection_candidates r WHERE r.source_ref IN (SELECT 'message:'||id FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning')) GROUP BY 1,2,3

proposal_triage.sql: SELECT j.judgment,j.mode,j.decision,COUNT(*) n FROM judgments j WHERE j.subject_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.improvement_id') FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.action')='social.learning' AND json_type(payload_json,'$.params.improvement_id')='text') AND j.judgment IN ('reflection_triage','proposal_prescreen','commons_idea') GROUP BY 1,2,3

judgment_modes.sql: SELECT judgment,mode,decision,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM judgments WHERE judgment IN ('commons_contribution','commons_idea','commons_grounding','knowledge_gap') GROUP BY 1,2,3

evidence_room.sql: SELECT json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.evidence_room_kind') kind,to_agent,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id')) threads,SUM(json_extract(payload_json,'$.params.summary.lane')='evolution-gym') gym,SUM(json_type(payload_json,'$.params.artefact')='object') artefacts,SUM(json_type(payload_json,'$.params.artefact.content')='text') artefacts_with_content,MAX(timestamp) last_at FROM agent_messages WHERE json_extract(payload_json,'$.thread_id') LIKE 'evidence-room:%' GROUP BY 1,2

falsifier.sql: SELECT kind,verdict,executed,COUNT(*) n,MAX(created_at) last_at FROM commons_falsifier_runs GROUP BY 1,2,3

review_queue.sql: SELECT status,COUNT(*) n,SUM(reply_count) replies,MAX(posted_at) last_at FROM commons_proposal_reviews GROUP BY 1

campaign.sql: SELECT json_extract(value,'$.campaign_id') id,json_extract(value,'$.status') status,json_extract(value,'$.started_at') started_at,json_extract(value,'$.ends_at') ends_at,json_extract(value,'$.minimum_pairs') minimum_pairs,json_extract(value,'$.latest_report_hash') report_hash,json_extract(value,'$.manifest.randomization') randomization FROM system_state WHERE key='social_learning_campaign:active'
